info.title: Afisha Curator Session and Public Occurrence API
info.description: СТАТУС (2026-11-13): исследовательский контракт сессий ассистента, вне базового контракта v1 и вне скоупа хакатона. Базовый контракт по ТЗ: contracts/api.openapi.yaml, событие: contracts/event.schema.json, инструменты агента: contracts/agent_tools.json. Research contract for Issue #13.No live server, real event or production behavior is asserted. Every accepted SessionPatch increments session_revision. Search, plan and replacement previews have separate allowlists. Saved plans are immutable; reject retains attention. All POST operations require the project Idempotency-Key convention. WidgetCapability is read-only and is accepted only for public occurrence details; it never authorizes session previews, patches, accepts or rejections. Cookie-based deployments must add CSRF protection.

OfferSnapshot.description: Null amount/currency/fees are unknown, never zero or free. sold_out is Offer availability, not Occurrence cancellation.

HardConstraints.description: Null means unknown. Unknown budget/age is not silently satisfied.

SoftPreferences.description: Soft preferences affect ranking only and never relax hard constraints.

SessionPatch.description: Every accepted patch increments session_revision. Unmentioned fields are preserved. clear sets unknown. Overlap between set/clear/keep and an empty effective patch are 422. Invalid/replayed requests create no new mutation.

plan_state.description: Durable state. draft is a UI projection of an unaccepted PlanPreview.

CreateSessionRequest.description: Web bootstrap requires a pre-issued HttpOnly bootstrap/session cookie so the first idempotency namespace is stable. Telegram session creation requires the server-to-server ChannelAdapterBearer and its mapped chat identity; a Web principal cannot self-select telegram identity.

SearchPreviewRequest.description: The server computes query_fingerprint from canonical current constraints; structured search does not require an LLM.

ResultPreview.description: occurrence_ids is the ordered search allowlist. occurrences must correspond exactly to these IDs and order. A late response for an old session_revision must not replace a newer result.

ComparisonPreview.description: occurrences must correspond exactly to occurrence_ids and order; every ID must belong to the referenced current search allowlist.

PlanPreviewRequest.description: Candidates must belong to the current search result allowlist; the plan snapshot cannot expand it.

ReplacementPreview.description: Has its own candidate allowlist. items is the complete final ordered plan, including unaffected items. It never mutates the saved snapshot before accept.

PlanAcceptRequest.description: Server checks preview kind/revision/expiry, current session/base plan revisions, the exact full ordered occurrence_ids and slot mapping. Same-key replay returns stored success; a new-key accept of a consumed preview is 409 preview_consumed without a new plan revision. occurrence_ids are unique. slot_mapping entries are unique as objects; the server additionally requires unique slot_id values and exact one-to-one correspondence with the full ordered occurrence_ids.

PlanRejectRequest.description: Reject retains the original plan_revision and attention; it never silently returns saved.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details; status equals HTTP status; no stack trace, secrets or foreign revisions. 409 mapping: revision_conflict=expected session/result/plan/preview revision or ordered-content mismatch; allowlist_conflict=ID outside the operation-specific allowlist; preview_expired=expires_at passed; preview_consumed=preview already accepted and a new idempotency key is used; idempotency_conflict=same principal/key with different method/path/payload.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Project convention, not claimed as an RFC standard. Namespace is (principal, key).

SessionCookie.name: afisha_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly Secure bootstrap/session cookie issued by the Web host before POST /v1/sessions, then bound to the created session. SameSite and CSRF defenses are deployment requirements.

ChannelAdapterBearer.description: Server-to-server channel adapter credential; never exposed to browsers, bots, models or URLs.

WidgetCapability.name: X-Widget-Capability
WidgetCapability.description: Optional read-only public-occurrence capability used by a widget BFF. Never sent in URLs or postMessage and never valid for session mutation.
